Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Puerto Rico’s ISO 3166-1 code (PR) as indicating a separate sovereign country and concluded the airports are in different countries. Puerto Rico is a U.S. territory under U.S. sovereignty, so both airports are in the same country (United States).
